channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Nominal raises $240M Series C at $3B valuation for its industrial-engineering AI agent
item.description: Nominal raised $240 million at a $3 billion valuation for its AI agent that automates root-cause analysis for industrial engineers, with the US Air Force adding a $71.2 million award.

item.description: OpenAI's new GPT-Live-1.1 voice model charges $0.02 a minute for idle time instead of $0.05, making always-on voice agents cheaper to run.

item.title: Google previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for large tool libraries
item.description: Google's Gemini API can now load an agent's tool definitions on demand instead of sending the whole library with every request, cutting token costs for agents with lots of tools.

item.description: Perplexity's Computer can now run a team of up to 16 AI agents on different models that share findings and check each other's work on complex tasks.

item.description: Meta's Muse AI agent is now available as a Chrome extension, with 200,000 people already using it in the browser sidebar.

item.title: Collate 2.1 brings open-context governance and MCP graph tools to enterprise AI agents
item.description: Collate 2.1 adds open-standards semantic modeling for enterprise data and an MCP server so AI agents can query business context as a graph, with human approval required before governance changes go live.
